newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lihir starts gold oxide ore processing.
newsitem.headline: Lihir starts gold oxide ore processing.

text.p: Papua New Guinea gold miner Lihir Gold Ltd said on Thursday it had started processing oxide ore at its plant on Lihir Island earlier on Thursday.

Lihir Chairman Ross Garnaut told Australian shareholders at a Melbourne information meeting that Lihir expected to pour its first gold before the end of the month and expected to produce 175,000 ounces in calendar 1997.
Lihir had previously said it expected to start processing next week.
Lihir plans to produce more than 550,000 ounces in 1998 and then about 600,000 ounces a year for 15 years.
Lihir is owned 22.9 percent by Southern Gold, which is itself owned 75 percent by RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd and 25 percent by Vengold Inc.
Niugini Mining Ltd owns 17.15 percent and the PNG government and landowners 17.5 percent.
